intent: Verify Compatibility and Accuracy of Modified Build List
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to inadequate cooling system
suggested_solution: Replace original CPU cooler with a white non-SE version of the Peerless Assassin, upgrade RAM to better spec all-white RAM, switch to a less expensive but still good-spec power supply unit with 3 separate PCIe cables for optimal power delivery, add an all-white set of individually sleeved PSU extension cables for improved aesthetics, and install additional case fans
